description: The plot titled “Training Loss of 20M Data Size” illustrates how training loss changes over training steps for multiple model variants trained on a 20M dataset, with a main panel covering early-to-mid training and a smaller right-hand panel showing a later-step zoom after an axis break. The x-axis is labeled “Step” on a linear scale; in the main panel it spans from 0k to 80k with labeled ticks at 0k, 20k, 40k, 60k, and 80k, and in the right panel it spans from 420k to 440k with labeled ticks at 420k, 430k, and 440k. The y-axis is labeled “Train Loss” on a linear scale; the main panel shows values from 0.0 up to about 0.75 (with labeled ticks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4 visible), and the right panel shows a narrower low-loss range (approximately 0.0 to 0.1). Six solid lines without markers are shown: a red line (ChemBART Small 20M) that starts near the top of the plot around ~0.8 at the earliest steps and decreases steadily to roughly ~0.10 by ~80k, then sits around ~0.04–0.06 in the 420k–440k window; a blue line (ChemBART Medium 20M) that similarly drops from roughly ~0.8 early to about ~0.08–0.10 by ~80k and is around ~0.03–0.05 in the 420k–440k window; a green line (legend entry present but text not visible due to an overlaid gray block) that begins near ~0.8 and declines to about ~0.11–0.13 by ~80k, then appears around ~0.05–0.07 between 420k and 440k; an orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) that decreases from roughly ~0.8 early to about ~0.08–0.10 by ~80k and is around ~0.03–0.05 in the 420k–440k window; a purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) that drops from roughly ~0.7–0.8 early to about ~0.06–0.08 by ~80k and is around ~0.02–0.04 between 420k and 440k; and a brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) that declines from roughly ~0.7–0.8 early to about ~0.05–0.07 by ~80k and is around ~0.02–0.03 in the 420k–440k window.
